train_student: COEVO_HINT_LEVEL=HINTER COEVO_TEACHER_HINT_MODE=open_hinter COEVO_TEACHER_HINT_URL="$COEVO_HINTER_URL" COEVO_TEACHER_HINT_MODEL="$COEVO_HINTER_MODEL" COEVO_TEACHER_HINT_API_KEY="${COEVO_HINTER_API_KEY:-EMPTY}" python scripts/collect_dosage_curriculum.py --manifest "{curriculum_manifest}" --source-trajectories "{source_trajectories}" --output-dir "{round_dir}/student_data" --samples "${COEVO_ALTERNATING_SAMPLES:-100}" && COEVO_POLICY_BASE_MODEL="{student}" bash scripts/train_student_full.sh "{round_dir}/student_data/student_gkd.jsonl" "{round_dir}/student" {student_steps} && python scripts/stages/checkpoint_result.py --checkpoint-root "{round_dir}/student" --refresh-role policy --output "{output}"
measure_pass_at_k: COEVO_HINT_LEVEL=HINTER COEVO_TEACHER_HINT_MODE=open_hinter COEVO_TEACHER_HINT_URL="$COEVO_HINTER_URL" COEVO_TEACHER_HINT_MODEL="$COEVO_HINTER_MODEL" COEVO_TEACHER_HINT_API_KEY="${COEVO_HINTER_API_KEY:-EMPTY}" python scripts/run_dosage_curriculum.py --output-dir "{round_dir}/dosage" --task-ids $COEVO_ALTERNATING_TASK_IDS --k {pass_k} --policy hstar --student-profile-manifest "{curriculum_manifest}" && python scripts/stages/probe_result.py --manifest "{round_dir}/dosage/dosage_manifest.json" --output "{output}"
train_hinter_grpo: python scripts/filter_hinter_grpo_dataset.py "$COEVO_HINTER_GRPO_DATASET" "{curriculum}" "{round_dir}/scheduled_hinter_grpo.jsonl" --profile-manifest "{round_dir}/dosage/dosage_manifest.json" && COEVO_CURRENT_POLICY_CHECKPOINT="{student}" COEVO_HINTER_BASE_MODEL="{hinter}" COEVO_HINTER_TUNER_TYPE=full bash scripts/train_hinter_grpo.sh "{round_dir}/scheduled_hinter_grpo.jsonl" "{round_dir}/hinter" {hinter_steps} && python scripts/stages/checkpoint_result.py --checkpoint-root "{round_dir}/hinter" --refresh-role hinter --output "{output}"
rollback_student: bash scripts/stop_role.sh policy && bash scripts/start_role.sh policy "{previous}"
rollback_hinter: bash scripts/stop_role.sh hinter && bash scripts/start_role.sh hinter "{previous}"
